target.tool: Customer-verified business interface; process-reference restrictions apply

key.note: Preserve source identifiers in an audit ledger; map regenerated internal IDs and target numbering. Never assume internal IDs survive migration.

structures.preprocessing: Unscoped candidate rows. Approve the full-key population at cutover; use customer-cohort-project.json. BOMs and routings need key date, engineering change, usage, alternative and selected-node resolution. Preserve alternative sequences and dependencies. Production orders are process references unless the chosen target interface explicitly supports their state; confirmations, goods movements and costs must not be reposted as master data. Preserve confirmation/counter identity and reversal relationships; do not delete reversals and assume the remaining history is net yield. Target order/operation mapping and posting periods must be approved. Reposting confirmations can trigger backflush, goods movements, activity allocations and accounting; confirmation history is reference-only unless a supported process migration explicitly authorizes those effects.
